question: what is the percentage change in the after-tax share-based compensation cost from 2009 to 2010?
reasoning: We need the after-tax share-based compensation cost for 2009 and 2010. From Note 11: share-based compensation cost (pre-tax) for 2010: $18.1 million, 2009: $14.6 million. Income tax benefit: 2010: $(6.3) million, 2009: $(5.2) million. So after-tax cost = pre-tax - tax benefit. 2010: 18.1 - 6.3 = 11.8 million. 2009: 14.6 - 5.2 = 9.4 million. Percentage change = (11.8 - 9.4)/9.4 = 2.4/9.4 = 0.255319... = 25.53%. So answer ~25.5%.
